🚨🇲🇽 <u>"MEXICO IS NOBODY'S PIÑATA" — SHEINBAUM RIPS US INTERFERENCE</u>

Before 130,000 at the Monumento a la Revolución, Sheinbaum said it is "legitimate to doubt" US intentions when Washington dictates extradition trials, names 10 Mexican officials including ex-Sinaloa governor Rocha Moya, and runs operations in Chihuahua that left two US agents dead. "When external actors decide who is guilty and who is not, we are no longer talking about cooperation — we are talking about interference." She floated the obvious: US sectors positioning for their 2026 midterms, or trying to bend Mexico's 2027 vote.

🔥🇲🇽 <u>12 CABINET MINISTERS EARN MORE THAN SHEINBAUM — ARTICLE 127 IGNORED</u>

Of 15 secretaries who filed 2026 declarations, 12 reported 2025 net salaries above the president's, in apparent violation of Article 127 of the Constitution. Sheinbaum reported 1.79 million pesos net; Science Secretary Rosaura Ruiz reported 3.011 million — nearly double. Only Rosa Icela Rodríguez (Gobernación), Roberto Velasco (SRE), and infrastructure chief Esteva Medina were under the cap. The austerity republic is policed at the top before anywhere else.

🇲🇽✊ Sheinbaum at the Monument to the Revolution today: "In 1992, Salinas privatized our water rights — opening them to commercial trade. It led to hoarding and corruption." "With the new National Waters Law, we brought them back to the nation. We de-privatized 4.6 billion cubic meters of water that had been concentrated in a few hands." — Presidenta Claudia Sheinbaum Pardo Tijuana, Mexicali, and small campesinos got their rights restored. Neoliberalism, line by line, being undone.

🔥🇲🇽 Sheinbaum drew the line at the Monument to the Revolution: "A sellout right, willing to celebrate and even promote pressure from foreign politicians. A right that goes so far as to invite the Spanish far-right to pay tribute to Hernán Cortés. Commentators who travel abroad to speak badly of Mexico." — Presidenta Claudia Sheinbaum Pardo 500 years later, the Mexican opposition is still siding with the conquistador.

🇲🇽🏭 The numbers Sheinbaum read out at the Monument to the Revolution today: — Peso at 17.40 to the dollar, up from 19.65 a year ago. Second-most-appreciated currency on Earth against the dollar. — Record foreign direct investment: $23.591 billion in Q1 2026, +10.4% YoY. — Unemployment at 2.5% — among the three lowest in the world. — 669,000 new jobs. April 2026 the highest formal employment month in Mexican history. — Trade balance positive for the first time in many years. — Presidenta Claudia Sheinbaum Pardo, dos años del triunfo This is what an economy looks like when it isn't run from abroad.

🔥🇲🇽 Sheinbaum, speaking from the Monument to the Revolution, named it directly: "The 2006 electoral fraud brought the spurious Felipe Calderón to power. He filled this country with death — through a failed war on drugs in which the alliance with a drug cartel was amply demonstrated. That was the narco-government." "And let's not forget Operation Fast and Furious — the pact that let thousands of U.S. high-powered weapons enter our country." — Presidenta Claudia Sheinbaum Pardo When the U.S. press lectures Mexico about cartels, this is the history they erase.

🇲🇽✊ Sheinbaum closed her two-year anniversary speech with a call to mobilize: "Starting next week — go to the public plazas. Hold assemblies. Hand out flyers and newspapers. Tell the people: the homeland is not for sale. It is loved and defended." — Presidenta Claudia Sheinbaum Pardo The 4T does not retreat into palaces when pressured. It goes back to the streets.

🇲🇽🌎 Sheinbaum at the Monument to the Revolution, marking two years since her victory: "We collaborate. We coordinate. But we never subordinate ourselves — and we never will. The fathers and mothers of this homeland paid a heavy price for our sovereignty." — Presidenta Claudia Sheinbaum Pardo A direct response to Washington after the April 19 incident — when two unaccredited U.S. agents died in Chihuahua while operating without authorization on Mexican soil.

🚨🇲🇽 "Mexico is nobody's piñata." "When from abroad they dictate who is guilty and who isn't, when they pressure our institutions from outside, when they normalize the idea that another country can intervene in matters that belong only to Mexicans — that's not cooperation. That's interference." — Claudia Sheinbaum, two-year anniversary speech, Monument to the Revolution The line came after the U.S. Department of Justice requested the urgent extradition of 10 Mexican citizens — including a sitting governor, a mayor, and a senator — without presenting public evidence.

🇲🇽🌎 UNAM: WORLD CUP 2026 WILL SUPERCHARGE RENTS AND INEQUALITY IN HOST CITIES

UNAM researchers in the colloquium "The City as a Global Showcase" warn the 2026 World Cup will spike rents and deepen urban inequality across CDMX, Guadalajara and Monterrey — and barely retreat once the tournament ends. Per-square-meter prices are already exploding in Coyoacán and Tlalpan near Estadio Azteca. In Monterrey, June inventory has dried up, pushing families to the periphery away from work centers. Around Akron Stadium in Guadalajara, fixed-rental housing is being wholesale-converted to furnished suites at peak-season prices. FIFA's "global showcase" runs the same script every cycle — Qatar, Russia, Brazil. The Brugada–Sheinbaum rent reforms are the only counterforce prior host cities didn't have.
